title: Opening: Monday. Morning at home
notes: Scene Book, Opening: Monday, sections 3 and 4. Approved by Jim, Nov 21, 2026. The words are the Scene Book's.
Quest log entries are the Scene Book's section 3.
"The phone gains pull." shows as a notice after the phone choice, from the Scene Book's stage note.

effects.title: Raise the Standard
effects.objective: Get through Monday. Tonight, write one line you won't cross.

effects.title: Your shift
effects.objective: 7:00 to 3:30 at the job site. The game records whether you show up, honestly.

text: The alarm goes off at 6:30. It has gone off at 6:30 for three years.
The phone is already lit. Eleven notifications. You don't remember leaving it there, face up, a foot from your head. You never do.
Nothing is wrong. That's the part nobody would notice. Rent is paid. The job is fine. You're fine. You've said "fine" so many times it doesn't sound like a word anymore.

choices.label: Get up.
result: Cold floor. You have time for coffee.

choices.label: Check the phone. Just a minute.
result: It isn't a minute. It's forty. The relief is real: for forty minutes nothing asks anything of you. Then it's 7:10.
choices.record: 40 minutes on the phone before getting up.

choices.label: Snooze.
result: Nine more minutes. Then nine more. You're up at 6:48 with less morning and no more rest.
